kcc_query_text_example: General category large farmer with 12.5 acres borewell-irrigated land in Savanur taluk, Haveri; applying for micro-irrigation capital subsidy under PMKSY-PDMC for exactly 5.00 hectares (~12.36 acres); seeking confirmation of 5.00 ha statutory ceiling compliance and vendor quotation requirements.

landholding_details.physical_area_consistency: PASS: requested 5.00 ha <= 12.5 ac (5.059 ha) qualifying parcel; satisfies PMKSY-PDMC 5.00 ha statutory ceiling

water_and_irrigation.grid_connection_evidence: HESCOM energized 10 HP IP set; partial sprinkler network installed

prior_subsidy_history.factual_declaration: First-time micro-irrigation applicant; applicant and beneficiary family have never previously availed micro-irrigation capital assistance on this parcel or any other holding.

statutory_clauses.section_7_9_area_ceiling: Section 7.9: Financial assistance is limited to 5.0 hectares per beneficiary family (either in contiguous or distributed parcels). S058 requests exactly 5.00 ha within a 12.5 ac (5.059 ha) parcel.
statutory_clauses.section_7_10_repeat_subsidy_restriction: Section 7.10: Assistance restrictions apply to beneficiaries who have already received micro-irrigation subsidy, imposing a mandatory 7-year lock-in period before becoming eligible again. Because applicant has never availed micro-irrigation subsidy, this 7-year repeat-assistance restriction is fully satisfied.
statutory_clauses.engine_mapping: prior_micro_irrigation_subsidy_years_ago = None strictly represents confirmed zero prior subsidy, firing rule PMKSY_NO_PRIOR_SUBSIDY.

statutory_flags.tenure_documentation: RTC registered pre-February 2019 in Savanur taluk, Haveri district

attribute_provenance.empirical_baseline: DES Karnataka & Haveri Agriculture Department: Commercial soybean-cotton growers in Savanur/Shiggaon taluks, large landholdings investing in precision drip irrigation.
attribute_provenance.farmer_query_inspiration: KCC Haveri micro-irrigation logs: Large farmers requesting PMKSY-PDMC subsidy clarification regarding the maximum 5.00 ha subsidy ceiling and physical parcel accommodation.
attribute_provenance.statutory_policy_test: Benchmark Challenge 8 & Boundary Test: Large holding of 12.5 acres (> 10.0 ac); requested subsidized area of exactly 5.00 ha strictly satisfies physical parcel capacity (5.00 ha <= 12.5 ac * 0.404686 = 5.0586 ha) and statutory ceiling (5.00 ha <= 5.00 ha) pursuant to PMKSY-PDMC Revised Operational Guidelines 2023 Section 7.9; Section 7.10 repeat-assistance restriction satisfied by explicit first-time applicant declaration (null mapped to PMKSY_NO_PRIOR_SUBSIDY); operational borewell satisfies water requirement; raw engine INELIGIBLE (PMKSY_LAND_ABOVE_5_HA) preserved; governance presentation qualifies in Section A at 5.00 ha statutory ceiling; confirms grid connection excludes PM-KUSUM B; existing borewell excludes Ganga Kalyana.

intended_test_purpose: Challenge 8 and boundary test: PMKSY-PDMC 5.00 ha ceiling at exactly 5.00 ha requested (PMKSY-PDMC 2023 Guidelines §7.9); explicit first-time applicant status (§7.10 7-year lock-in satisfied); 12.5 ac / 5.059 ha physical capacity PASS; PMKSY-PDMC qualifies in Section A; Ganga Kalyana and PM-KUSUM B disqualified by existing grid borewell.
